accessDenied.title: No delivery access
accessDenied.reason: Your role cannot manage deliveries at {branch}.

header.title: Live deliveries
header.subtitle: Where your riders and live orders are right now.
header.introSelf: Every delivery order at {branch} from the moment it is placed until it is handed over. You deliver these yourself — move each one along with the buttons on its card.
header.introPlatform: Every delivery order at {branch} from the moment it is placed until it is handed over: where the rider is, how long until it arrives, and who is waiting. Riders approved here also appear on the map whenever they are online, even between jobs.

map.noPin: This branch has no map pin yet, so there is nothing to draw riders against. <link>Set it in Branch settings</link>.

list.title: In flight
list.loadError: Could not load deliveries. Refresh the page to try again.
list.ridersError: Could not load riders. Trying again every 15 seconds.
list.emptySelf: A card appears the moment someone places a delivery order at {branch}, and stays until you mark it delivered.
list.emptyPlatform: A card appears the moment someone places a delivery order at {branch}, and stays until the food is handed over. {ready} of {total} approved riders are ready right now.
list.emptyPlatformNoRiders: A card appears the moment someone places a delivery order at {branch}, and stays until the food is handed over. {ready} of {total} approved riders are ready right now — no rider is approved for this branch yet.
list.stalled: {count, plural, one {# stalled order} other {# stalled orders}}
list.stalledHint: Older than 12 hours and still waiting. Kept off the map — cancel or assign them from here.

card.withRider: Food is with the rider — refund it from Orders if it cannot be delivered.

detail.kitchenReady: Kitchen says ready — no rider has been asked yet
detail.kitchenStatus: {status, select, pending {Kitchen: pending} confirmed {Kitchen: confirmed} preparing {Kitchen: preparing} ready {Kitchen: ready} out_for_delivery {Kitchen: out for delivery} completed {Kitchen: completed} cancelled {Kitchen: cancelled} refunded {Kitchen: refunded} other {Kitchen: {status}}}
detail.askedRiders: {count, plural, one {Asked # rider so far} other {Asked # riders so far}}
detail.selfStaff: Your own staff deliver this one
detail.offerExpired: Offer expired — returning to the pool
detail.etaUnknown: ETA unknown — waiting for the rider’s GPS

dispatch.maxAttempts: Tried every rider — raise “Max dispatch attempts” or assign one by hand.
dispatch.notEntitled: Delivery isn’t included in this restaurant’s plan.
dispatch.notDispatchable: This delivery is no longer waiting for a rider.
dispatch.authRequired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again, then search for a rider.
dispatch.notAuthorized: You don’t have permission to send riders for this branch.
dispatch.failed: Couldn’t search for a rider. Try again.
dispatch.noPin: This branch has no map pin yet — set it in Branch settings.
dispatch.noneApproved: No rider is approved for this branch yet.
dispatch.noneOnline: No rider is online right now ({approved} approved).
dispatch.noLocation: {online} online, but none have shared a location — the rider app must be open with location permission granted.
dispatch.gpsStale: {online} online, but no location newer than {minutes} min. The rider app only sends GPS while it is open in the foreground.
dispatch.allBusy: {online} online, all already on a delivery.
dispatch.outOfRangeMiles: {online} online, but none within {miles} mi — raise “Driver search radius”.
dispatch.outOfRange: {online} online, but none within the search radius — raise “Driver search radius”.

rpcErrors.driverBusy: That rider is already on a delivery.
rpcErrors.driverNotEligible: That rider is not approved here or their documents are not verified.
rpcErrors.alreadyAccepted: The rider has already accepted — they must hand it back from their app before you can reassign.
rpcErrors.notAssignable: This delivery can no longer be assigned by hand.
rpcErrors.forbidden: Your account cannot manage deliveries at this branch.
rpcErrors.authRequired: Your session has expired — sign in again.
rpcErrors.notFailed: Only a failed delivery can be re-dispatched.
rpcErrors.notSelfDelivery: This branch uses platform riders; the rider moves the delivery from their app.
rpcErrors.badTransition: That step is not available for this delivery any more.
rpcErrors.notAuthorized: Your account cannot cancel this order.
rpcErrors.cannotCancelStatus: This order can no longer be cancelled.
rpcErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

assign.title: Assign {number} to a rider
assign.intro: The rider gets a normal offer they can still decline — it just goes to the one you pick instead of whoever auto-dispatch scores highest.
assign.noRiders: No rider is approved for this branch yet, so there is nobody to offer this to.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}?
cancel.body: This cancels the order, restores stock and takes the delivery off the board. It can’t be undone.
cancel.why: Why? The customer sees this on their order page.

notOffered.stillInFlight: Runs that were already out still finish here. This board closes once the last one lands.
